case_title: JALPAT RAI & ORS. v. STATE OF HARYANA
statutory_provisions: IPC s.302, s.149; Arms Act s.27
trial_court_outcome: Convicted A-2 under s.302 IPC and s.27 Arms Act, acquitted others
neutral_facts: The prosecution case was that on the fateful day, two individuals were sitting in their office. At that time, four individuals arrived at their office, all armed with firearms. The complainant suspected their movement due to previous business rivalry. After about 10-15 minutes, another individual arrived at their office, also carrying a firearm. Fearing danger, the complainant called his brother, who arrived shortly after. The complainant party closed the office and while leaving for their homes, one of the accused fired a shot from behind with a licensed pistol. The complainant and his nephews ran towards the accused but the accused fired another shot that hit one of the complainant's associates on the left side of his chest. Another accused fired a shot that hit another associate on the left side of his chest. The accused then started firing shots from their firearms, resulting in injuries to two individuals. The injured were taken to hospital, where two of them succumbed to their injuries and died. The trial court convicted one accused under s.302 IPC and s.27 Arms Act, but acquitted the other accused due to the unreliability of the prosecution's eyewitness testimony and its contradiction with the ballistic expert's report.
